newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU confirms clearance of Norsk Hydro deal.
newsitem.headline: EU confirms clearance of Norsk Hydro deal.

text.p: The European Commission confirmed on Monday it had cleared plans by a Dutch unit of Norwegian oil and gas giant Norsk Hydro to buy Enichem's fertiliser unit at Terni Industrie Chimiche SpA.
In a statement, the EU executive said it had concluded that the deal would not create or strengthen a dominant position on any market.

On each of the markets, Norsk Hydro would either face competition from major rivals or the addition of market shares would be insignificant, or entry into the market was relatively easy for other producers.
Under the deal that was announced on September 5, Hydro Agri Nederland BVA, a unit of Norsk Hydro, acquires control of Terni Industrie Chimiche, a wholly owned subsidiary of Enichem.
The Commission said Norsk Hydro had previously acquired the major part of the fertiliser business of Enichem, which it cleared in late June.
Also that decision was the result of restructuring and liquidation of Enichem which was examined and approved by the Commission last year.
Enichem is still retaining its Sariaf fertiliser business.
